reconcile.note: John Gill ascribes Jonah's casting into the sea to God as the ultimate cause working through the sailors named as its human agents.

discrepancy.emptyNote: Steve Wells presses the plain wording as a real conflict, since one verse credits the sailors and the other credits God with throwing Jonah into the sea.
discrepancy.emptyNoteAttr: Steve Wells (1999), The Skeptic's Annotated Bible (1999).

sides.snippet: they took up Jonah, and threw him into the sea
sides.verseText: So they took up Jonah, and threw him into the sea; and the sea ceased its raging.

sides.snippet: For you threw me into the depths, In the heart of the seas.
sides.verseText: For you threw me into the depths, In the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
